U-Doyun wathi, 'Amapuleti angu-4 angu-3 namapuleti angu-3 angu-4 ahlanganiswe ngokuhlukile, ngakho inani lama-apula lizohluka nalo.'

y-m-04-11.material: U-Eunwoo uthole iphethini ngenkathi ekhumbula ithebula lokuphindaphinda ngo-9. 'Ethebuleni lokuphindaphinda ngo-9, isikhathi ngasinye lapho umkhiqizo ukhula ngesinyathelo esisodwa, idijithi lamashumi liyakhuphuka nge-1 futhi idijithi labodwa liyehla nge-1.' (isibonelo, 9, 18, 27...) Uma umkhiqizo uyinombolo yedijithi elilodwa, thatha idijithi lamashumi njengo-0. Ake sicabange ngokelula ithebula lokuphindaphinda kusuka ku-9×1 kuya ku-9×11.

y-m-04-11.prereq.1: Ukwazi idijithi lamashumi nedijithi labodwa lenombolo yamadijithi amabili (izinga lebanga 2)
